schema_note: Business field proposals only; this catalog does not replace or extend the shared implementation schema.

scope.real_connection: No endpoint/auth required. Mock exported-file inputs and native file outputs; connections remain empty.
scope.multi_source_packaging: Separately named logical export tables are bundled in the shared case JSON payload. Physical multi-file native ingestion is not established.
native_blockers: Approved Computer Use tools must be restored.
An unlocked accessible session and parent authorization are required.
No alternative browser, private API, token, cookie, shell, or custom runner workaround.
Historical output publication outcome is unknown after Publishing.
forbidden_actions: Quality release, scrap, inventory movements or reservations
Shop-floor control, production authorization or actual kitting
Publication, push, auth or EULA changes
Backend, custom MCP, Azure/external services, runtime installers or external scheduler

common_semantics.time: Explicit as_of; no runtime wall clock. ISO date bounds 2000-01-01 through 2100-12-31; each boundary is documented.
common_semantics.quantities: Whole EA quantities 0-1000000, positive lot/order quantities, no booleans. Decimal strings only for explicitly decimal fields.
common_semantics.size_policy: At most 200 records per source table; fictional safety limit, not an ERP or platform limit.
common_semantics.duplicates: Identical event-ID duplicates collapse once with an exception. Conflicting same-ID rows reject; identical values with different IDs are distinct.
common_semantics.missing: Absent evidence never implies zero, pass or availability. Missing required structure rejects; unknown references are explicit unresolved work.
common_semantics.ordering: Input order does not choose winners. Candidate-specific business sort with case-sensitive ASCII ID final tie-break; stable exceptions.
common_semantics.independence: All case assertions below are manually reasoned proposals, not baseline-generated answers. Complete goldens must be written before executing baseline.
common_semantics.result_envelope: Use only the shared schema_version/status/outputs/exceptions envelope at implementation.
common_semantics.baseline: Developer-only no-Creator Python stdlib solve(payload)->(result,events) through scenario_support.run_cli; not native proof.
common_semantics.trace: Actual execution snapshots for all six shared kinds; first input, last output; meaningful row decisions and conservation totals, never copied goldens.
common_semantics.media: Foundation centrally renders actual demo trace, about 30-90 seconds, explicitly synthetic and not Cowork/live ERP.

source_backed_concepts: Inspection evidence links to purchase-source inventory and quality requirements.
Nonconformances and correction/retest work require explicit treatment.
Sampling quantity and physical hold quantity are not interchangeable.
sample_policies: Demo: three specimens, inclusive 4.90-5.10, certificate valid through as_of, overdue when age strictly exceeds five days.
Requirement version uses receipt date; exactly one applicable requirement per required test.
Passing retest supersedes a failed observation only through an explicit approved link; cycles/ambiguous links reject.
Retain all reasons; precedence: unresolved identity, failed test/open NC, evidence gaps, evidence-complete QA review.
Unknown item means unresolved specification; missing hold snapshot means unknown quantity, never zero.
Sort category data/NC/gap/complete, age descending, then lot_id.
candidates.main_branch: Complete consistent evidence produces a QA review packet, never a released lot.
candidates.loops: Each lot, required test and specimen; bounded explicit retest chain.
candidates.manual_approval: QA/material review outside the workflow; no release, scrap, physical movement, signature or certificate issuance.
output_invariants: Every lot has approval_required=true and production_authorized=false.
Received quantities reconcile once per physical lot; hold transactions are not blindly added.
Rejected cases contain explicit errors and no success-shaped packet.

candidates.title: Supplier delivery performance and shortage expediting review queue
candidates.trigger: Daily or manually requested review of frozen purchase-delivery and shortage exports.
candidates.start: PO delivery lines, posted receipt/reversal events, confirmations, pegged unmet requirements and vendor ownership plus as_of/month/policy.
candidates.end: Reconciled supplier performance and ordered unsent buyer-review queue with evidence questions.

inputs_proposed.config: as_of, reporting_month, horizon_days, tolerance_days, urgency_days, low_performance_percent

stages.observable: Export counts and as_of/reporting month/horizon.
Source IDs, quantities, dates, event and reversal consistency.
Schedule-to-receipt/vendor/demand matches.
Active/voided events, net/on-time/open quantities.
Eligible/excluded line IDs, OTIF numerator and denominator.
Latest eligible receipt-date promises and future/conflicting evidence.
Per-requirement confirmed coverage and uncovered quantity without reuse.
Unknown IDs, absent/stale confirmations, overreceipts and exclusions.
Priority, needed date, shortage and stable line ID ordering.
Unsent review work and reconciled performance scope.

source_backed_concepts: Delivery schedules, confirmations, arrival registration and product receipts are distinct.
Ship dates must not be substituted for receipt dates.
sample_policies: Cohort uses original requested receipt date in reporting month and no later than as_of; cancelled/future/unknown rows have separate exclusions.
OTIF: non-voided quantity received by requested date plus tolerance meets ordered quantity; count lines, not receipt events.
Full reversal posted by as_of voids original receipt for all metrics; unmatched, partial or repeated reversals are not guessed.
Credit receipts only up to ordered quantity; report overreceipt separately. Empty denominator is null. Percent uses two-place decimal half-up.
Latest confirmation recorded by as_of wins; conflicting equal-date promises reject; future evidence is excluded/reported.
Past unreceived ETA is not available supply. Unknown ETA is not on-time.
Allocate confirmation quantity once across a line's unmet requirements by need date/requirement ID; do not subtract historic receipts from unmet demand twice.
Demo horizon 10, urgency 3, low-performance flag below 90; these are configurable fictional policies.
P1 critical uncovered requirement due within urgency window, including overdue; P2 other shortage or overdue original delivery; P3 remaining confirmation review.
Sort priority, earliest need date with unknown last, uncovered quantity descending, line ID. History is evidence, not an automatic supply-risk multiplier.
candidates.main_branch: Reconcile past receipts, explain future uncovered needs and assign unsent review work.
candidates.loops: Each purchase line, posted event, vendor cohort and line-pegged requirement; confirmation supply cannot be reused.
candidates.manual_approval: Buyer reviews all proposed questions and performs any communication or PO amendment outside the workflow.
output_invariants: Past-receipt metrics and future promise coverage remain separate.

candidates.start: Work orders, versioned BOM lines, item masters, site stock and inbound snapshots plus horizon policy.
candidates.end: Exploded requirement ledger, conserved shadow allocation, shortage review plan and unresolved evidence requests.

stages.observable: Order horizon and source inventory counts.
Quantities, masters, dates, version ambiguity and graph bounds.
Order-to-approved-valid version selection and explicit alternatives.
Actual component paths and exact multipliers.
Per-order/component raw sum and once-rounded EA demand.
Site/status/expiry/reservation/receipt-date eligible supply with reasons.
Order sequence, source usage, remaining pool and component gaps.
Late/blocked/expired supply, unknown masters, unsupported lines and shortage rows.
Demand = assigned + shortage, plus source-level conservation.
Review-only material states and owner questions; no actual reservations.

source_backed_concepts: BOM validity can depend on date, site and quantity.
Approval differs from active-default selection; explicit approved valid alternatives exist.
Phantoms expand into leaf material requirements; other line types have different effects.
Blocked inventory must not be treated as available stock.
sample_policies: Exactly one approved active default version; explicit alternative may be inactive but must be approved and valid. Inclusive date ranges; ambiguous match rejects.
Only Item/Phantom and EA; max eight levels/5000 expanded paths, detect cycles; unsupported types fail explicitly.
Propagate exact phantom multipliers; no phantom scrap. Sum leaf parent_quantity*quantity_per*(1+scrap_percent/100) by order/component then ceil once.
quantity_per is a canonical decimal string with <=4 fractional places; scrap_percent 0-25.
Site-appropriate available nonexpired stock contributes physical minus external reservations. Hold/blocked rows contribute zero without double subtraction.
Expiry-controlled stock without expiry is unknown. Confirmed inbound counts only when as_of < expected_on <= need_by; overdue unreceived inbound is not stock.
Allocate by start date, priority ascending, order ID. Stock before future inbound; eligible sources by earliest expiry/date then ID.
Conservative report-local partial assignment; no optimizer, automatic backtracking, reservations, or authorization to kit.
candidates.main_branch: Explode valid BOMs and produce a conserved review-only material coverage/shortage plan.
candidates.loops: Orders, bounded graph paths, aggregated leaf components, and eligible supply sources with non-reused shadow balances.
candidates.manual_approval: Engineering/stores/planning review all evidence and any substitutions, reservations, releases or schedule changes outside this process.
output_invariants: Each stock/inbound source is assigned at most once up to eligible capacity.
Covered-now, covered-with-expected-receipt and shortage review states are distinct; none authorizes production.
